title.zh: 各向异性自由边界 Picard 平衡

summary: Run a bounded gyrotropic-pressure and cell-current Picard loop using caller-supplied pressure closure and Green responses, with an optional ideal-conductor flux correction after each update.

identity.relation: vacuum flux and field, dense cell-current Green responses and caller pressure closure to a bounded anisotropic R-Z equilibrium state
identity.direction: R-Z grid, vacuum state, Green matrices, pressure closure and controls -> final flux/field/pressure/current state and iteration diagnostics
identity.definition: Initialize psi, BR and BZ from the supplied vacuum state. At each step, form poloidal B, call the supplied closure with {psi,B,params}, compute gyrotropic toroidal current, relax masked cell currents and apply dense Green responses. Optionally apply an ideal-conductor correction to projected psi only, then measure its relative change. Stop when residual <= tol or the nonnegative maxiter bound is reached; reevaluate B, closure and current on the returned state. For maxiter=0, perform this terminal reevaluation without a Picard update and expose a zero initial current state.
identity.model: axisymmetric gyrotropic-pressure Picard composition with caller-owned N4 pressure closure and optional linear ideal-conductor wall correction
identity.geometry: finite, strictly increasing, uniformly spaced tensor-product cylindrical R-Z grid with at least three samples on each axis
identity.coordinates: fields indexed [Z,R]; Green source and field axes use C-order flattened grid points
identity.boundary: Vacuum fields are additive references. Optional wall correction changes psi after Green projection but does not recalculate BR/BZ from that correction or itself impose a zero boundary residual.
assumptions: The pressure_closure callback returns scientifically justified nonnegative co-located pressure arrays and optional density/temperature arrays for each state, interpreting psi as R A_phi in Wb/rad.
All flux and field Green matrices share the declared current basis and appropriate Wb/rad/A or T/A units.
No supplied pressure-closure parameter is interpreted by the graph except inserting B0 when absent; the caller owns its physical model.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.constraints: At least three samples per axis; strictly increasing, uniformly spaced tensor axis; same shape as z_grid.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.constraints: Same shape as r_grid; strictly increasing, uniformly spaced axial axis.

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum/external psi=R A_phi and initial Picard flux state.
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape; validated by the feedback dependency during iteration or the zero-step terminal branch.

inputs.name: br_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum radial poloidal field and initial BR.
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape; field-magnitude dependency validates finiteness before closure.

inputs.name: bz_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum axial poloidal field and initial BZ.
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape and co-located with br_vac.

inputs.name: g_psi
inputs.description: Dense source-cell-current to psi=R A_phi Green matrix.
inputs.constraints: Exact square grid-point size, with C-order source columns and field rows.

inputs.name: g_br
inputs.description: Optional source-current to radial-field Green matrix.
inputs.constraints: Supply together with g_bz; both absent leaves BR at br_vac.

inputs.name: g_bz
inputs.description: Optional source-current to axial-field Green matrix.
inputs.constraints: Supply together with g_br; both absent leaves BZ at bz_vac.

inputs.name: params
inputs.constraints: Shallow-copied before use; if B0 is absent, the graph inserts positive b0 or the initial field-magnitude median. Other keys are passed through without physical validation by this graph.

inputs.name: pressure_closure
inputs.description: Caller-provided pressure closure evaluated at current state.
inputs.units: psi Wb/rad, B T; pressure output Pa
inputs.constraints: Returns p_parallel, p_perp, density and electron_temperature; pressures must be finite nonnegative exact-grid arrays; latter two may be None or finite nonnegative exact-grid arrays.

inputs.name: tol
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive; compared with the post-boundary-correction residual.

inputs.name: maxiter
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative; zero skips the update loop but still runs terminal closure/current evaluation.

inputs.name: relax
inputs.description: Retention weight of previous relaxed cell currents.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= relax <= 1; this is current-state, not flux-state, relaxation.

inputs.name: b0
inputs.description: Positive reference field inserted into params.B0 only if that key is absent.
inputs.constraints: When needed, None uses the median initial field magnitude; an explicit value must be positive. An existing params.B0 is not replaced.

inputs.name: plasma_mask
inputs.description: Active-cell selector for feedback and terminal current.
inputs.constraints: Exact grid shape and bool dtype when supplied; False cells are zeroed for feedback and terminal current.

inputs.name: boundary_correction
inputs.constraints: When supplied, requires dimensionless boundary_sample_matrix [N_b,N_f] and Wb/rad/A green_boundary_to_boundary [N_b,N_w] and green_boundary_to_field [N_f,N_w]; optional rcond defaults to 1e-10. Matrix validation belongs to the wall Operator.

outputs.name: psi
outputs.description: Last wall-corrected or directly projected psi=R A_phi state.
outputs.constraints: At maxiter=0 equals psi_vac after terminal evaluation; optional wall correction changes psi only.

outputs.name: BR
outputs.description: Last radial field state from optional g_br feedback.
outputs.constraints: Equals br_vac when field Green matrices are absent, including on the wall branch.

outputs.name: BZ
outputs.description: Last axial field state from optional g_bz feedback.
outputs.constraints: Equals bz_vac when field Green matrices are absent, including on the wall branch.

outputs.name: B
outputs.description: Terminal poloidal magnitude from returned BR/BZ.
outputs.constraints: Reevaluated after bounded iteration; not reconstructed from wall-corrected psi.

outputs.name: profiles
outputs.units: p_parallel/p_perp Pa; density m^-3 or caller units; electron_temperature caller units
outputs.constraints: Contains exactly p_parallel, p_perp, density and electron_temperature from the terminal callback, after array validation.

outputs.name: j_phi
outputs.description: Terminal toroidal current density after optional mask.
outputs.constraints: Reevaluated at final psi and B; zero outside plasma_mask.

outputs.name: plasma_currents
outputs.constraints: Terminal j_phi times abs(dR*dZ), not necessarily the last relaxed feedback state.

outputs.name: picard_current_state
outputs.description: Last relaxed flattened cell-current feedback state.
outputs.constraints: At maxiter=0, the dependency's zero initial state is returned.

outputs.name: gradp_term
outputs.constraints: From unmasked terminal current decomposition; may be nonzero outside plasma_mask.

outputs.name: anisotropy_curvature_term
outputs.description: Terminal current remainder after isotropic comparison.
outputs.constraints: From unmasked current decomposition; may be nonzero outside plasma_mask.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: Whether the last measured flux change is at or below tol.
outputs.constraints: False when no update was performed; false at the bound is returned without raising solely for nonconvergence.

outputs.name: residual
outputs.constraints: Initially infinity for maxiter=0; finite after a successful update.

outputs.name: residual_history
outputs.description: Relative flux change after each completed update.
outputs.constraints: Empty when maxiter=0; otherwise one value per update.

outputs.name: parameters
outputs.description: Shallow-copied input parameters with inserted B0 if absent.
outputs.constraints: Other caller keys are not normalized by the graph.

outputs.name: boundary_currents
outputs.constraints: None without a completed wall correction; from the last update if enabled.

outputs.name: boundary_flux_correction
outputs.description: Last wall response at field flux points.
outputs.constraints: None without a completed wall correction; does not modify BR or BZ.

outputs.name: boundary_residual_norm
outputs.constraints: None without a completed wall correction; a nonzero value is allowed.

outputs.name: failure_reason
outputs.constraints: None when converged; otherwise 'maxiter_reached', including maxiter=0.

preconditions: The caller supplies a physically justified pressure closure and coherent vacuum/Green response on the exact same ordered grid.
The optional boundary matrices sample and correct the same flux basis; shape validation alone cannot prove physical consistency.
All bound dependencies accept the data encountered both during iteration and terminal reevaluation.
supported: Bounded anisotropic pressure/current Picard composition with a caller-selected N4 closure, optional field Green pair and optional ideal-conductor flux correction.
excluded: A built-in Frank-Egedal closure or independent validation of caller params and pressure physics.
Self-consistent reconstruction of BR/BZ from wall-corrected psi.
A general free-boundary equilibrium guarantee, automatic Green construction, or guaranteed Picard convergence.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for missing required ports, invalid grid, mask, controls, params mapping, closure output or incomplete wall config; dependency validation errors propagate. Non-mapping positional inputs are rejected by the composition layer with TypeError.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Callback, field/current/Green and wall-solver errors propagate without fallback. The graph does not independently check wall response consistency or all output arrays for post-arithmetic finiteness.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: After at most maxiter updates, return the last state with converged=false, failure_reason='maxiter_reached' and its history. maxiter=0 skips the loop, returns residual=inf and an empty history after terminal evaluation.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No mapping is returned after an exception. Bounded nonconvergence is a complete last-state mapping, not an exception.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel TaskGraph mapped to a saved Pleiades L1 N6 free-boundary Picard composition, YAML and direct graph regressions; historical review labels are development provenance, not expert recognition of this version.

example.description: A constant isotropic pressure and zero Green response complete one step without changing vacuum flux or field.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.equilibrium import solve_free_boundary_anisotropic_picard
r, z = np.meshgrid([0.2, 0.4, 0.6], [-0.1, 0.0, 0.1])
shape, size = r.shape, r.size
def closure(state):
    p = np.full(shape, 2.0)
    return {'p_parallel': p, 'p_perp': p, 'density': None, 'electron_temperature': None}
result = solve_free_boundary_anisotropic_picard(r_grid=r, z_grid=z, psi_vac=r.copy(), br_vac=np.zeros(shape), bz_vac=np.ones(shape), g_psi=np.zeros((size, size)), params={}, pressure_closure=closure, tol=1e-12, maxiter=1, relax=0.0)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['psi'], r)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['j_phi'], 0.0, atol=1e-12)
assert result['converged'] and result['iterations'] == 1 and result['failure_reason'] is None
example.expected: One converged update retains vacuum flux and zero toroidal current; no wall correction is applied.

scope: Zero-response one-step convergence and isotropic zero-current limit.
Two-step feedback changes flux and retains current state.

No-wall one-cell feedback matches direct circular-filament psi=R A_phi, BR and BZ at a selected off-source point, including one run with a real Frank-Egedal caller pressure closure and terminal pressure recomputation.
Optional wall branch corrects psi without changing BR/BZ when field Green matrices are absent.
Missing closure/controls, invalid grids, unpaired field matrices and malformed closure fields fail.
Zero-step branch and terminal-state current/pressure consistency.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct small-grid graph tests include finite no-wall circular-filament comparisons of all three returned fields, one using a Frank-Egedal caller closure under a matched Wb/rad flux coordinate. They do not establish arbitrary closure physics, wall-branch field/flux consistency, general Green validity, convergence or expert recognition.
known_limitations: params is mostly passed through; the graph does not independently implement or verify the caller's closure model.
Wall correction changes flux but not the magnetic-field Green response, so returned psi and BR/BZ need not be derivative-consistent.
The terminal profile/current can differ from the last update's source; public distribution licensing and expert recognition remain pending.

execution.ordering: Validate geometry and required ports, derive initial B and insert missing B0, then validate Picard controls. Invoke and validate caller closure, compute current, perform masked current relaxation and Green projection, optionally correct psi through the wall Operator, compute relative psi residual, then repeat while due. After stopping, recompute B, closure and current on the returned state before assembly.
branches: When boundary_correction is absent, use the projected psi directly and return null wall diagnostics.
When boundary_correction is present, correct projected psi after each update without changing projected BR/BZ.
At maxiter=0, skip updates but run terminal field/closure/current and return the zero current state, infinite residual and maxiter_reached.
When the finite bound is exhausted above tol, return the last state with converged=false and maxiter_reached.
execution.state_ownership: The graph owns evolving psi/BR/BZ, prior relaxed cell currents, residual and history; the caller owns vacuum state, Green matrices, fixed mask, parameter mapping and pressure_closure.
execution.failure_propagation: Invalid inputs, closure outputs and dependency failures abort without partial mapping. Only bounded nonconvergence yields a last-state mapping with failure_reason.

feedback.state: psi, BR, BZ, prior relaxed cell currents, residual history and update count
feedback.initialization: psi/BR/BZ start from vacuum inputs, prior currents are None, residual is infinity, history empty and count zero.
feedback.update_order: Evaluate field and caller closure on current state, compute toroidal current, relax cell currents, project Green flux/fields, optionally correct psi only, measure relative psi change, append history, then replace evolving state.
feedback.continue_when: residual > tol and executed updates < maxiter
feedback.stop_when: residual <= tol or executed updates reach maxiter, including the zero-step bound
feedback.nonconvergence: Return final reevaluated state with converged=false and failure_reason='maxiter_reached'; no hidden retry.
